label: Hadrian Biodefense
description: Hadrian Biodefense (formerly ProEquip) is a US nonprofit working to make sure civilisation can withstand and recover from severe biological crises, including AI-enabled pandemics. It focuses on respiratory protection: developing and evaluating powered air-purifying respirators and filters, and building PPE stockpiles for critical-infrastructure workers.

label: Global Shield
description: Global Shield is an international advocacy organisation that works to reduce global catastrophic risk from all threats and hazards, including engineered and natural pandemics worse than COVID-19. It works with governments on policy through country offices in the US and Australia and a multilateral programme.

label: Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP) @ CSIRO
intervention_focuses: Rapid diagnostics ; Pathogen surveillance ; Vaccines ; Therapeutics ; Lab biosafety
description: The Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness, run by CSIRO in Geelong, is Australia's highest-containment biosecurity laboratory and its national reference laboratory for animal and zoonotic disease threats. It diagnoses and researches emerging diseases such as H5 avian influenza and henipaviruses, taking a One Health approach. It was formerly the Australian Animal Health Laboratory.

label: Center for Communicable Disease Dynamics (CCDD) @ Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
description: The Center for Communicable Disease Dynamics at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health is a research and training centre for mathematical modelling of infectious disease dynamics. It informs outbreak and pandemic response, publishes frequently, and makes its modelling resources available to the public.

label: Renaissance Philanthropy - Big if True Science (BiTS) Biosecurity Accelerator
description: A biosecurity cohort of Renaissance Philanthropy's Big if True Science accelerator, funded by Coefficient Giving. It gives 10 to 14 participants structured training and one-to-one mentorship to design R&D and market-shaping programmes against biological threats, ending in a demo day where they pitch to philanthropists and ARPA-style agencies.

label: Langsikt
description: Langsikt, the Centre for Long-Term Policy, is an independent, non-profit Norwegian think tank focused on major global challenges such as pandemics, artificial intelligence and extreme poverty. Its work on biotechnology and pandemics includes arguing that Norway should treat vaccines as security policy.
